# golambda Provider

Builds reproducible AWS Lambda zip archives from Go packages in remote modules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    golambda = {
      source = "registry.opentofu.org/mattmoyer/golambda"
    }
  }
}

# Private github.com modules are fetched using GITHUB_TOKEN from the
# environment by default.
provider "golambda" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cache_dir` (String) Directory for downloaded toolchains, Go module and build caches, and default output archives. Defaults to `golambda` under the user cache directory.
- `github_token` (String, Sensitive) GitHub token used to fetch private modules from github.com. Defaults to the `GITHUB_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `goprivate` (List of String) `GOPRIVATE` patterns: modules fetched directly from their origin, skipping the public proxy and checksum database. Defaults to `github.com/<owner>` of each target when a GitHub token is available.
